purpose: Checkpoint the retrospective Worldshepherd utility audit covering all Glob discovery work accumulated so far and formalize the governed routing extension for non-physics as well as physics utility.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it can materially improve any project capability, or an explicit negative-control role when that is its only current value.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Mirrors, alternate landing pages, repeated database records and derivative copies of the same underlying source are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: A source may be highly useful to Worldshepherd while its matched number has zero Glob evidence; metadata or incidental numeric recurrence is not promoted unless it independently clears the declared evidence gates.

information_updates.finding: Everything covered so far in the Glob inquiry is now explicitly subject to retroactive utility review across scientific, engineering, software, security, manufacturing, operations, governance, commercial, partner, supply-chain, environmental and negative-control domains.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Retroactive utility enrichment does not alter historical Glob evidence classifications.

information_updates.finding: A governed routing extension now supplements the historical canonical route vocabulary without rewriting the registry, and CI validates the extension against the coverage audit.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Route vocabulary expresses capability use only, not evidence strength.

next_actions: Continue source-by-source retroactive utility backfill for previously accumulated publications and technical records whenever additional software, security, manufacturing, operations, business, supply-chain or partner uses are identified.
Continue the internet/raw-hit scan across all 208 union states while preserving domain-agnostic usefulness routing.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification independently for physical evidence candidates.
Maintain fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls for all numerical-evidence promotion.
